scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute!
I can't offer any of my
services to you because
you're carrying too much
stuff. Put your extra items in
Kafra Storage and come again~
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你身上的東西太多了，我沒法為你提供服務。
先把多餘物品存進卡普拉倉庫，再來吧~

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hey, hey...
If you bring me
1 Empty Bottle and
15 Zeny, I'll exchange
them for 1 Milk. How
does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[賣牛奶的人]
嘿，1個空瓶加15 Zeny，就能換1瓶牛奶。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hey...
You don't have
any Empty Bottles.
I can't really give you
this milk any other
way, you know...
scripts.translation:
[賣牛奶的人]
嘿...你沒帶空瓶啊。
沒有瓶子，我可沒法把牛奶給你...

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Oh, whoa~!
You don't have enough
zeny to exchange all
these Empty Bottles for
Milk. You need to have
at least {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[賣牛奶的人]
哎呀~你的Zeny不夠把所有空瓶都換成牛奶。
至少需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Milk Vendor]
Hmm...
Would you make
a little more room
in your inventory
before I give you
all of this milk?
scripts.translation:
[賣牛奶的人]
嗯...給你這些牛奶之前，能先把背包騰出點空間嗎？
